keywords: 原生 AA 让 Tempo 用户更容易迁移到后量子签名
STEEL 团队提出 EIP-8037 修订方案
Canton 上 USDC 转账需 Circle 签名之问
summary: 周六。gakonst 表示由于原生 AA，Tempo 用户迁移到后量子签名会更容易，只需给现有账户添加新密钥，无需转移资产，再停用非后量子密钥。STEEL 团队提交 EIP-8037 修订草案，试图解决实现与测试中发现的问题。bkiepuszewski 质疑 Canton 网络上的 USDC 转账都需要 Circle 签名。

keywords_en: native AA makes Tempo's move to post-quantum signatures easier
does every USDC transfer on Canton need a Circle signature
summary_en: A Saturday. gakonst said native AA makes it easier to migrate Tempo users to post-quantum signatures: add a new key to the existing account without moving assets, then disable the non post-quantum keys. The STEEL team submitted a draft revision of EIP-8037 addressing issues found in implementation and testing. bkiepuszewski questioned whether every USDC transfer on Canton requires a Circle signature.
